title: Tax Metric2 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: TurboTax returns (`turbotax:return`), IRS transcripts (`irs:transcript`), tax estimates (`tax:estimate`), tax payments (`tax:payment`), and W-2 imports (`w2:import`).
app: TurboTax return exports, IRS transcript pulls, tax estimate calculators, payment confirmations, and W-2 import logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tax:metric2
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day tax metric2 (2) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on tax metric2 (2) events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It scans what time of day your tax metric2 (2) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
